mentions.name: Zoupyu
mentions.description: This tool lets users paste a long video, automatically suggests the best moments using AI, and lets them pick the start and end points to turn them into clips, giving full manual control over each second. It is planned to expand into a platform that brings creators and clippers together through content rewards.
mentions.problem: Most AI clippers just pick the moments for you, so the author wanted a tool that gives full control over each second instead.
mentions.audience: Content creators and clippers who want to turn long videos into clips
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Zoupyu (https://zoupyu.com). You paste a long video, it suggests the best moments, and you pick the start and end points which then become clips.
mentions.author: vedanshchauhan9
